reviews.title: Very disappointing customer service and unclear charging
reviews.text:
I placed an order with Boutiqaat for 57 OMR, and I specifically selected Oman as the country and Omani Rial (OMR) as the currency. At checkout, the total shown was 57 OMR, including shipping and all applicable country charges.
However, 59.200 OMR was charged to my credit card, which is different from the amount confirmed at checkout.
I immediately contacted Boutiqaat through WhatsApp to report the issue. I was told that someone would call me back. After making a second complaint, I received a missed call that lasted approximately one second. Immediately afterward, I received a message saying that they had tried to contact me but there was no answer.
This is not an acceptable way to handle a customer complaint. If you genuinely wanted to resolve the issue, a one-second missed call followed by closing the complaint cannot be considered proper customer service.
I am not complaining only about the 2.200 OMR difference; I am more concerned about the lack of transparency and how my complaint was handled. My money was deducted, and no one properly followed up or took responsibility for resolving the issue.
I hope Boutiqaat reviews this case seriously, explains why the amount charged was different from the amount displayed at checkout, and improves the way customer complaints are handled.

reviews.title: Delivery issues
reviews.text:
I placed an order worth around 60 KD, and I was charged 2 KD for delivery.

Two days later, I received an email early in the morning saying that my order was out for delivery. However, by the evening, nothing had arrived.

I called your customer service, and they told me the delivery would arrive at 11:00 p.m. I explained that this was unacceptable. It’s not Ramadan, people have work the next day, and most of us are asleep by then. They apologized and assured me they would ask the driver to deliver it before 10:00 p.m.

Unfortunately, the driver didn’t call until 11:30 p.m., by which time everyone was asleep, so no one answered the phone. As a result, I still haven’t received my order.

I don’t understand why I’m being charged 2 KD for delivery if the delivery time is so unreliable and doesn’t respect customers’ schedules.
